stem: Which statement about the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) is true?

options.text: It is mandatory for every autism diagnosis
It can replace a full developmental assessment
A diagnosis can often be made using parent history and school feedback
It is the main tool used by social workers for family support
It is the only assessment required to confirm autism spectrum disorder

explanation: A diagnosis can often be made using parent history and school feedback. The ADOS-2 is a useful assessment tool, but it is not always required as the sole basis for diagnosis.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because the ADOS-2 is not mandatory for every autism diagnosis.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because it does not replace a full developmental assessment.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because autism diagnosis can often be reached using information from parent history, school feedback, and clinical assessment rather than relying on the ADOS-2 alone.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the ADOS-2 is a diagnostic observation tool, not a family support tool used by social workers.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the ADOS-2 is not the only assessment required to confirm autism spectrum disorder.

source.hint: Reflect on whether this specific tool is the only way to reach a clinical conclusion.
